display_name: NDMA & State Heat Action Plan (HAP) City Alert Triggers
provider: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) & Municipal Corporations

color_code_alert_standards.Yellow: Watch and Update: Moderate heat risk. Public awareness and hydration advisories.
color_code_alert_standards.Orange: Be Prepared: High heat risk for vulnerable groups. School shifts adjusted, outdoor labor restricted.
color_code_alert_standards.Red: Take Action: Extreme heat emergency. Non-essential outdoor labor prohibited 11am-4pm, cooling centers active.
